name: i2c_master_regs
desc: I2C master: transaction control, target address, length, SCL divider and status, done interrupt.

params.name: DIV_RST
params.desc: DIV at reset: the larger of CLK_HZ / (4 SCL_HZ) and the phase that makes SCL low (2 phases) last the UM10204 tLOW minimum (4.7 us up to 100 kHz, 1.3 us up to 400 kHz, 0.5 us above), minus 1

registers.name: CTRL
registers.desc: transaction control; reads EN / READ / NO_STOP as stored, START reads 0

fields.name: START
fields.desc: write 1: start the transaction (a command, reads 0)

fields.name: READ
fields.desc: 1: read, 0: write (bytes from the AXI-Stream slave)

fields.name: NO_STOP
fields.desc: 1: no STOP at the end (repeated START next)

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: status; write 1s to [3:1] to clear those flags

fields.name: DONE
fields.desc: transaction finished (W1C; also cleared by START)

fields.name: DONE
fields.desc: irq_o while STATUS.DONE: the transaction finished (acknowledged or not)
